card.name: Years and names in scholarly citations
card.fires_on: The digit 9 inside a four-digit year such as 1973 or 1994 in bibliographic or biographical references. It also fires weakly on 'of' or 'Philosophy' in philosopher names and journal titles.

modes.label: Digit in a year
modes.description: The digit 9 or 7 in the middle of a 19xx year in a citation or life-dates range.
